text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout 2024-11-02 09:12Z - eu-west-1 observing p95 latency +45% and error rate +18% vs baseline. Auto-rollback threshold (error_delta >= 15%) would have triggered but `manual_rollback_lock=true` is set. Notifying eng-releases.
Alice: Eva (oncall) can you confirm infra is clean? we need a rollback decision fast.
Eva: Checking metrics/logs now. Not seeing AZ level networking issues. Errors are 5xx from model-serving processes; stack traces show kvcache misses and occasional OOMs on a subset of pods.
Pranav: Confirmed: several Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 received v2.7.2 canary. Traffic slice is 10%. My recommendation: manual rollback to 2.7.1 to err on the side of stability. Plan: pin to 2.7.1, run rollback script, verify healthchecks, hold canary.
Alice: :thumbsup: Pranav — please execute. Share the command.
Pranav: Running:
```
./deploy/rollback.sh --env eu-west-1 --target=2.7.1 --dry-run=false --force
```
I'll run and monitor. ETA ~5m.
Maria: Product note: prepare a short customer-facing blurb for Dedicated EU customers. We should be proactive: say we paused the update and reverted to stable while we investigate.
Alice: @cs-team can you draft that? keep it one paragraph and non-technical.
cs-team: Draft below — please review:
"We paused a scheduled update in eu-west-1 after observing increased latency for a subset of requests. We've reverted affected pools to the previous stable version (2.7.1) and are monitoring closely. No action required from customers. We'll follow up with a detailed update once we have root cause."
:mailbox_with_mail:
Eva: Rollback started — operator pranav initiated. Logs: `starting rollback -> switching traffic -> verifying healthchecks`
deploy-bot: Action accepted: rollback initiated by Pranav at 09:20Z. Healthchecks reporting GREEN on primary nodes; canary traffic reduced to 0%. Post-rollback p95 returned to baseline within ~2 minutes.
Alice: Release notes freeze for this rollout. Do not re-promote 2.7.2 until eng-runtime and eng-ml confirm kvcache/oom fix. Schedule follow-up postmortem tomorrow 10:00am.
Maria: I'll update the release notes and mark 2.7.2 as paused/pending fix, and ensure changelog mentions the rollback.
Pranav: Created ticket: #rollback-eu-2024-11-02 (owner: Pranav). Action items: collect failing request samples, dump KV sizes, confirm quantization kernel path. Tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml.
cs-team: Sending customer note now to impacted accounts and account teams. Will escalate high-touch customers if requested.
Alice: :white_check_mark: Good work everyone. Closing loop here; if anything degrades re-open and call @oncall.
